audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields refer to Sivir as 'him/his' (she/her per champ-gender.js); dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles instead of describing the trigger named by their own title.

audit.corrected: Swapped pronouns to her/she across all flagged fields; rewrote dosFull[1].d to describe tracking Spell Shield's timer for the root call, and dontsFull[2].d to describe wasting Featherstorm on poke.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Deadly Plumage' in spikes[0].text as a possible wrong ability name, but that is Xayah's own W and is correct as written — no change made. The brief's missingInteractions entry claims Sivir's Spell Shield can deny Featherstorm (R), but Featherstorm is a self-cast leap with no single-target component, so Spell Shield (which only blocks a targeted spell cast ON Sivir) does not apply to it per the kit text — left unaddressed rather than adding an inaccurate interaction; flagging for review.
